name: Ubiquiti UniFi
author: Netlens
description: Reads the UniFi Network application (UniFi OS consoles such as Dream Machine, Cloud Key Gen2+, Cloud Gateway, or a self-hosted classic controller): your gateway, switches and access points, which device hangs below which, and which switch or access point every client is connected to, with Wi-Fi signal and link rate. Read-only: one login, a few reads and a logout per sync.

config.label: Controller address
config.help: The address you open UniFi at: https://<console> for a UniFi OS console (port 443), https://<server>:8443 for a classic self-hosted controller.

options.label: UniFi OS console (Dream Machine, Cloud Key Gen2+, Cloud Gateway)

config.label: Username
config.help: Use a separate local account with read-only access, without two-factor authentication (a cloud / Ubiquiti SSO account does not work).

config.label: Site
config.help: The name of one site as shown in UniFi (or its short id, usually default). Leave empty to read every site the account may see.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: UniFi consoles use a self-signed certificate unless you installed your own. Leave this off in that case.
